name: med-dosage-study
title: Dataset for the medication dosage study of DataTools4Heart/AI4HF.
description: Heart failure related medications prescribed at discharge, their daily doses and the daily doses as a percentage of the target doses, together with gender and CKD severity, for the Clinical Study 1 population of DataTools4Heart and AI4HF projects.

entity.name: pid
entity.description: A unique identifier assigned to each patient in the cohort.

entity.name: encounterId
entity.description: A unique identifier for each hospital encounter.

sampling.description: Use the end time of encounters as the reference time point

feature.name: gender
feature.description: Gender of the patient

feature.name: age
feature.description: Age of the patient at admission date

feature.name: categorizedValue
feature.description: Severity of chronic kidney disease: LOINC 69405-9

filter.name: validSerumCreatinine
filter.description: Filter valid creatinine [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma (mg/L)

feature.name: value
feature.description: Latest serum creatinine value recorded during the encounter. If missing, falls back to the average of the last 2 values recorded over the three years preceding the reference time point; if still missing, falls back to a random value drawn from the interquartile range (25th-75th percentile) of this feature within the population currently being extracted.

filter.name: validWeight
filter.description: Body weight (kg), restricted to physiologically plausible values (20-300 kg)

feature.name: value
feature.description: Latest body weight (kg) recorded within the year before discharge, restricted to physiologically plausible values (20-300 kg). Used to choose the carvedilol target dose. Left empty if there is none.

filter.name: acei_captopril
filter.description: Prescriptions of captopril (ATC C09AA01, C09BA01)

feature.name: prescribed
feature.description: Whether captopril (ATC C09AA01, C09BA01) is prescribed, i.e. there is a prescription for it starting within the year up to 1 day after discharge, regardless of its dosage. False if there is none.

filter.name: acei_captopril
filter.description: Prescriptions of captopril (ATC C09AA01, C09BA01) with a calculated daily dose

feature.name: dailydose
feature.description: Daily dose of captopril (ATC C09AA01, C09BA01) from the prescription closest to 1 day after discharge, i.e. the latest prescription starting within the year up to 1 day after discharge. Calculated as dose × frequency / (period × days in periodUnit), taking a missing frequency and period as 1 and a missing periodUnit as d, and expressed in the unit of the prescribed dose.

feature.name: perctargetdose
feature.description: Daily dose of captopril from the same prescription as dailydose, as a percentage of the target daily dose of 150
